verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents a VerificationSession API that tracks each verification and shows results on completion. Results can be read programmatically with a secret key, and status-change webhooks let an automated flow react. Nothing in the pack shows structured failure-reason codes or exposed risk signals an agent could branch on. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable failure/error reason codes, exposed risk or fraud signal fields, per-check result schema detail, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven branching.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on

citations.quote: This API tracks a verification, from initial creation through the entire verification process, and shows verification results upon completion.
You can access most verification details programmatically... using your secret key.
Listen for verification results so your integration can automatically trigger reactions.
Stripe generates events every time a session changes status.
